services.desc: Issaquah, WA - Lake Sammamish Paddle Co. & Outfitters by Wheel Fun Rentals is inviting outdoor enthusiasts to experience the beauty of Lake Sammamish like never before with the launch of its new Guided Kayak Tours. Led by experienced local guides, these relaxing on-the-water excursions offer guests an unforgettable opportunity to explore the lake’s peaceful shoreline, abundant wildlife, and breathtaking Pacific Northwest scenery. Launching from Tibbetts Beach in Lake Sammamish State Park, these guided tours are perfect for beginners and experienced paddlers alike.
